filename: T1 - Third ventricular pilocytic astrocytoma ventricle 021.jpg
description: Centered on the 3rd ventricle is a mass lesion that is iso-intense to grey-matter on T1 weighted imaging and hyperintense on T2. There is not significant diffusion restriction, but there is avid peripheral enhancement that has a foliated pattern.
